featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very smooth and satisfactory experience with my claim process at HDFC ERGO Health Insurance. The entire journey—from hospitalization to claim settlement—was handled efficiently and transparently.
The cashless claim process was quick, and the coordination between the hospital and the insurance team was well managed. There were clear communications at every step, and the approval process did not cause unnecessary delays. Most importantly, there were minimal deductions, which reflects fair claim assessment.
I would also like to specially mention Niraj Shinde – Health Insurance Expert, who helped me select the right policy. His knowledge of health insurance is excellent, and he guided me properly based on my needs. During the claim process as well, he was very helpful, supportive, and always available for assistance.
This experience reinforced the importance of having a good health insurance policy. In medical emergencies, financial stress can be significant, but with the right insurer and expert guidance, the burden becomes much lighter.
I would strongly recommend everyone not to delay buying health insurance. A reliable policy not only provides financial protection but also ensures peace of mind during critical times.
Overall, I appreciate HDFC ERGO for their prompt service, transparency, and customer support.

featured_reviews.name: naveen nathrani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sharing a serious and unresolved issue involving both a shipping line and a marine insurer, highlighting significant gaps in accountability and claims handling.
Two containers were shipped together on the same voyage with Interasia Lines Ltd. One container was delivered in sound condition, while the other arrived totally damaged at destination. In accordance with standard procedures, a damage survey was conducted within 24 hours of receipt.
The shipment was insured with TATA AIG Insurance under ICC (A) – All Risks cover, including War Risk policy. A marine insurance claim was duly lodged (Claim No. 4300160663A) with all documents that were available and requested at the time. The last communication from TATA AIG was on 02/06/2025, and the claim remains unsettled.
Despite:
ICC (A) All Risks coverage,
Timely damage survey, and
Clear evidence of selective damage (one container intact, one totally damaged),
Interasia Lines Ltd. has declined responsibility for the cargo damage, and TATA AIG Insurance has failed to bring the claim to a fair and timely conclusion.
For exporters and businesses, marine insurance and reliable shipping are meant to provide protection—not prolonged uncertainty. This experience raises serious concerns about post-shipment accountability, claims efficiency, and customer commitment.
This is shared in the interest of awareness and accountability, with the expectation that both parties act responsibly and resolve genuine cargo damage claims.
#TATAAIG

featured_reviews.name: Bhavesh Vekaria
featured_reviews.review_text:
⚠️ Absolute Disregard for Customers - Bajaj Allianz Travel Insurance ⚠️

Post my review in AUG-23, Bajaj has reponded to mail them all the details and ensured to get it resolved ASAP. However, to my utter disappointment, no mail & its follow up reminders were answered at all....Ref No. BA-3573

Detail:

I am utterly dismayed by the appalling service and complete lack of accountability displayed by Bajaj Allianz Travel Insurance. Three weeks ago, I shared my nightmarish experience with this company, and I had hoped that they would take steps to rectify the situation. Unfortunately, my hope has been shattered, and I must share an update on this ongoing ordeal.

To recap, I purchased a policy for my spouse on 16-4-23, only to encounter a system error that prevented the transaction from completing after I had already paid Rs 3545/-. A Bajaj Allianz officer assured me of a refund and even issued a new proposal, but what followed was a never-ending cycle of broken promises, endless email exchanges, and an unresponsive customer care team.

Despite my diligent follow-ups with multiple individuals at Bajaj Allianz, including Mr. Mayuresh, Mr. Rohit, and Mr. Akshay, as well as repeated attempts to contact their customer care, I am dismayed to report that I have not received any refund or even a satisfactory response. Their verbal assurances of processing my payment seem to have been empty words.

I must now question the integrity of a company that cannot address a legitimate customer complaint. Is it unreasonable to expect accountability when their system failed to issue the policy I paid for?

What's more, it is astonishing to witness Bajaj Allianz's blatant disregard for customer concerns. This disregard is especially shocking when it comes to refunding premiums that were erroneously collected.

Even their so-called customer care, which should serve as a channel for resolution, has proven to be equally negligent. I followed their provided escalation details, yet my refund remains elusive. To add insult to injury, it appears they have conveniently closed the case without resolution.

I can only imagine how many other innocent customers have fallen victim to their unprofessionalism and lack of accountability, forfeiting their hard-earned money for non-existent policies.

⭐️ Rating: 1 out of 5 stars ⭐️

Bajaj Allianz's actions, or lack thereof, have left me deeply disheartened and frustrated. Their indifference towards customer concerns is simply inexcusable.

Despite their initial response, which suggested a willingness to rectify the situation, I am sad to report that my subsequent attempts to contact them have gone unanswered. It is abundantly clear that they have no intention of taking any meaningful action or arranging for the refund that is rightfully mine.

This level of disregard from a company associated with the Bajaj Group is deeply concerning. I implore anyone considering Bajaj Allianz Travel Insurance to think twice. Your time, money, and sanity are far too valuable to be sacrificed on a company that treats its customers with such disrespect and neglect. Avoid Bajaj Allianz Travel Insurance at all costs, and seek insurance providers that prioritize their customers' well-being and satisfaction.
